text:
jen: Heads up — after switching sample-apps to Edge and setting "type": "module" in package.json, CI started failing. Local vitest passes but GitHub Actions runs (node 18) fail with import/interop errors. Anyone seen this?

alex: Can you drop the GH failure snippet?

jen: From actions: 
```
FAIL tests/auth.test.ts
  Test suite failed to run
  /home/runner/work/repo/node_modules/our-sdk/dist/index.js:1
  import { createClient } from './client';
  ^^^^^^
  SyntaxError: Cannot use import statement outside a module
```

maya: Classic ESM/CJS CI pain. A few notes: Jest needs either experimental vm modules or you must use babel-jest/ts-jest configured for ESM. Vitest often needs deps.inline for ESM node_modules.

alex: Example that worked for us — keep package.json as "type":"module": use a jest.config.cjs (so Node loads it as CJS) and enable extensionsToTreatAsEsm: ['.ts'] and a transform using babel-jest. Also set NODE_OPTIONS=--experimental-vm-modules in the Actions job.

jen: We tried babel-jest already. Repo is hybrid — new SDK is ESM-only but test harness and many deps are still CJS. CI still errors on importing exported-default packages from node_modules.

tom: Two immediate approaches: 1) Add transformIgnorePatterns exception so those ESM node_modules are transpiled by Babel/Jest, e.g. transformIgnorePatterns: ['/node_modules/(?!our-sdk|some-esm-pkg)/']. 2) Add a tiny CJS shim in test helpers that require() an ESM loader wrapper and re-export a CJS-compatible shape. Both ugly but unblock CI.

maya: For Vitest, in vite.config.ts set test.deps.inline: ['our-sdk'] or optimizeDeps.exclude depending on whether you want pre-bundling. If running in Edge runtime locally, consider using environment: 'edge' for parity but Node env is less brittle in CI.

alex: Also check tsconfig moduleResolution: 'bundler' or 'node16' — some TS projects needed that to avoid type-only import resolution errors when mixing ESM tools.

jen: Another wrinkle: a bunch of legacy tests use jest.mock, new ones use vi.mock. Could that mix break things?

maya: Mixing mocks doesn't directly break, but inconsistent transformers can. If jest can't parse the SDK file because it's ESM, mocking layers never apply.

jen: Plan — try adding transformIgnorePatterns exception + set NODE_OPTIONS in GH actions and rerun. If green, we can implement a longer-term fix: publish a CJS compatibility build or convert tests to ESM mocks.

tom: If you want a tiny repro, create a minimal monorepo with one ESM-only package and a CJS test runner package. Easier to debug than a full app.

ci-bot: workflow/tests.yml#L52 — re-run triggered by jen with NODE_OPTIONS set.

jen: Thanks team — I'll open a PR with the Jest change and CI env tweak and ping for review. Please attach any small repros if you have them. :pray:
